title: Azure AI Agent Service Target Configuration
description: Custom configuration for the Azure AI Agent Service target

resources.description: List of external resources for agent execution.

toolConnections.description: List of tool connections to external services (MCP tools, A2A, custom APIs) created during provisioning.

toolboxes.description: List of toolboxes (Foundry Toolsets) to deploy.

connections.description: List of project connections to create via Bicep provisioning.

memoryStores.description: List of Foundry memory stores to provision (create-if-not-exists) during deployment. Memory stores let agents retain context across sessions via the memory_search tool.

startupCommand.description: Command to start the agent server (e.g., 'python main.py'). Used by 'azd ai agent run' for local development.

kind.description: The agent kind. 'hosted' for a containerized/code agent; 'prompt-voice' for a declarative (managed) speech-to-speech voice agent.

modelType.description: Voice agent (kind: prompt-voice) model-inference mode. 'managed' uses a Voice Live-hosted model; 'self_deployed' (BYOM) references an existing Foundry model deployment.

model.description: Voice agent (kind: prompt-voice) speech-to-speech model (e.g. id: gpt-realtime).

id.description: Model name for managed mode (e.g. 'gpt-realtime') or existing Foundry deployment name for self_deployed mode.

instructions.description: Voice agent (kind: prompt-voice) system prompt for the assistant.

voice.description: Voice agent (kind: prompt-voice) output voice name (e.g. 'en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural' for an Azure Neural voice, or 'alloy' for an OpenAI realtime voice).

store.description: Voice agent (kind: prompt-voice) server-side logging toggle (transcript + per-turn audio). Defaults to false when omitted.

displayName.description: Optional human-friendly display name for the agent.

metadata.description: Optional metadata key-value pairs for the agent.

protocols.description: Invocation protocols the agent implements (e.g., responses, invocations, invocations_ws, a2a).

agentEndpoint.description: Agent endpoint configuration (protocols, version selection, auth).

agentCard.description: A2A discovery metadata for the agent.

policies.description: Governance policies attached to the agent (e.g., Responsible AI).

inputSchema.description: Optional input schema for the agent.

outputSchema.description: Optional output schema for the agent.

allOf.$comment: A prompt-voice agent must declare a speech-to-speech model; the deploy path rejects a voice service whose model.id is missing. Keep editor/schema validation aligned with that runtime requirement.

codeConfiguration, policies, protocols, agentEndpoint and sessionConfiguration are hosted-agent-only: load/deploy conversion drops them for every other kind, so accepting them elsewhere validates configuration that silently has no effect. Reject them up front, matching the runtime check in ValidateAgentDefinition.

The activity.publish block is shared publish metadata for Activity use cases (including simple). Digital Worker adds stricter requirements: publish must exist, publishScope must be tenant, and agenticUserTemplate is required to carry the persisted blueprint identity.

ActivitySettings.description: Activity-protocol Teams configuration. The publish block is shared metadata for Activity use cases; digital_worker applies additional constraints via allOf.

publish.description: Shared Microsoft 365 app publish metadata used by Activity use cases. For digital_worker, publishScope=tenant and agenticUserTemplate are required.

ProtocolVersionRecord.description: A protocol the agent implements, with its version.

CodeConfiguration.description: Code deploy configuration. When present, the agent is deployed from source (ZIP) instead of a container image.

entryPoint.description: Entry point for the agent source.

SessionConfiguration.description: Optional hosted-agent session runtime settings. When omitted, the service applies its defaults (idle timeout 900 seconds).

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: Idle duration in seconds before a session's sandbox is suspended. Range 300–3600 (inclusive). Defaults to 900 when omitted.

Policy.description: A safety or governance policy attached to the agent.

raiPolicyName.description: ARM resource ID of the RAI policy (for type 'rai_policy').

InvocationsModeration.description: Configures how the content-safety proxy extracts the text it submits to the RAI policy. Only supported for agents that expose the 'invocations' protocol; without it an attached RAI policy has nothing to moderate on that path.

inputContentType.description: How the request body is encoded. Defaults to 'json'.

outputContentType.description: How the response body is encoded. Defaults to 'json'.

responseMode.description: Response shapes the agent container can produce. This declares a capability, not an input/output switch: the proxy runs exactly one output gate per response, chosen from the actual response Content-Type.

inputPaths.description: JSONPath expressions selecting request text. Required when inputContentType is 'json' or omitted.

outputPaths.description: JSONPath expressions selecting buffered response text. Required when responseMode includes non-streaming and outputContentType is 'json' or omitted.

streamSelectors.description: Locates text within server-sent event frames. Required when responseMode includes streaming and outputContentType is 'json' or omitted.

InvocationsInputIsJson.description: Matches when inputContentType resolves to 'json', i.e. it is set to 'json' or omitted entirely (the default).

InvocationsOutputIsJson.description: Matches when outputContentType resolves to 'json', i.e. it is set to 'json' or omitted entirely (the default).

SseTextSelector.description: Locates the text to moderate inside a single server-sent event frame.

eventType.description: SSE event name this selector applies to.

textField.description: JSONPath expression, relative to the frame payload, holding the text.

ContainerSettings.description: Container configuration for the Azure AI Agent Service target

ResourceSettings.description: Resource configuration for the Azure AI Agent Service target

DeploymentModel.description: Model configuration for a model deployment.

ToolConnection.description: A connection to an external service (MCP tool, A2A, custom API) created via Bicep during provisioning.

name.description: Connection name used as project_connection_id in toolbox tools.

target.description: Target endpoint URL for the connection.

credentials.description: Credentials for the connection. Values may contain ${ENV_VAR} references resolved at provision time.

Toolbox.description: A reusable collection of tools deployed as a Foundry Toolset.

tools.description: List of tools in the toolbox. Each tool is an object with properties passed to the Foundry Toolsets API.

Connection.description: A project connection matching the Bicep ConnectionPropertiesV2 spec.

target.description: Target endpoint URL for the connection.

credentials.description: Authentication credentials. Structure depends on authType.

authorizationUrl.description: OAuth2 authorization endpoint URL (required for OAuth2 authType).

tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL (required for OAuth2 authType).

refreshUrl.description: OAuth2 token refresh URL (optional for OAuth2 authType).

scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes to request (optional for OAuth2 authType).

connectorName.description: Connector name for Oauth2 auth type.

isSharedToAll.description: Whether the connection is shared to all users.

sharedUserList.description: List of users the connection is shared with.

useWorkspaceManagedIdentity.description: Whether to use workspace managed identity.

MemoryStore.description: A Foundry memory store provisioned (create-if-not-exists) during deployment. Backs the agent's memory_search tool so the agent can retain context across sessions.

chatModel.description: Chat model deployment name used by the memory store (must exist in the Foundry project).

embeddingModel.description: Embedding model deployment name used by the memory store (must exist in the Foundry project).

options.description: Optional extraction and retention settings for the memory store.

defaultTtlSeconds.description: Default time-to-live (seconds) for new memory entries. 0 means no expiration.

userProfileDetails.description: Guidance on what user-profile information the agent should retain or avoid.
